description.describe_ch: 介紹現行工廠生產形式，了解生產作業概念，並建立可以描述工廠佈置作業之數學模型，例如：前置時間、操作時間、產能、使用率等，利用數學模型來分析決定自動化策略，同時評估各種方法優劣及成本，計算損益平衡以決定機具績效，之後再進一步進行自動化生產線的生產流程分析，以平衡生產線的機具負荷，組成生產製配站，其間並介紹裝配製程、系統、自動化裝配生產的設計。自動化工廠中的主要模組，倉儲運輸、加工、裝配、檢驗等各模組的結構及效率分析、操作控制，在工廠中的配置以達成期望的自動化生產目標。
description.describe_eh: The purpose of this course is to introduce the types of modern automatic factory layout and mathematic models of the factory production line. So that automation stratogies can be chosen based on minimize operation time, transportation time, nonoperation time, …etc. After evaluation of different investments, and break-even analysis, production line balance was performed to organize work stations so that optimum production line efficiency can be achieve.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Classroom behavior should always be timely, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. Effective learning requires respect for classmates, teachers, and other instructors. To ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to adhere to the following classroom rules of conduct and cultivate a culture of courtesy.
1. Students are expected to attend class on time. If you are unable to attend class on time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or have an emergency, you must arrive in class and be seated before class begins. If you must leave class early for any reason, please notify me in advance.
2. All students are expected to respect everyone in class and behave in a reasonable, responsible, and courteous manner at all times.
3. Do not talk, read, sleep, or do other non-coursework during class. Minimize side conversations except during group discussions. If you are seated next to someone who might engage in conversation during class, please move to another seat to avoid succumbing to temptation.
4. Listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When presenting, you should face your group or the entire class and speak loudly so that your classmates can hear you clearly.
5. Laptops and tablets are permitted for note-taking in class; otherwise, they should be put away.
6. Mobile devices such as cell phones and PDAs must be turned off, put away, and kept on silent mode during class.
7. Headphones are not permitted in class.
8. Dress neatly and avoid revealing clothing.
